title: Map blocks (world, US, Spain, choropleth, bubbles, flow arcs)
what_it_does: Choropleth/bubble/hex/flow-arc map scenes: world-map, us-map, us-map-bubble, us-map-flow, us-map-hex, spain-map.
when_to_use: Geography stories, where something happens or spreads.
needs: d3 7.9.0, topojson-client, world-atlas/us-atlas/es-atlas JSON from jsDelivr at render time
why: Official. They fetch map data from a CDN while rendering, so a render needs network unless the data is vendored; note this in the part's README. No Turkey map exists: that one would have to be written.
